items.stem:
Using standard alphabetic filing, which name is filed FIRST?
R & S Hardware | R Best Laundry | R Cruz Pharmacy | Rabago Store

reveal.terms: A symbol such as & is indexed as if spelled out ("and") and is its own unit.
reveal.why_correct: Units: R / and / S / Hardware. The second units are and, Best, Cruz; "and" is first. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 2), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o1: Files first only if "&" is skipped. Spelled out as "and", R & S comes before R Best.
why_wrong.o4: "R" alone comes before "Rabago": nothing comes before something.

distractor_subreason.o1: CLR-LETTER-ORDER: skips the symbol, breaks ARMA Rule 2

items.stem:
Using standard alphabetic filing, which name is filed LAST?
Lucky Star Bakery | Luz Bakeshop | The Luz Garden | Luz of the Valley Resort

reveal.terms: A leading "The" becomes the last unit. Other minor words (of, the, and) inside the name stay where they are, as units.
reveal.shortcut: Move a leading "The" to the end first; leave inner minor words alone.
reveal.why_correct: Second units among the Luz names: Bakeshop, Garden, of. "of" is last, so Luz of the Valley Resort is last. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 2), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o2: "Lucky" comes before "Luz", so it files first, not last.
why_wrong.o3: "Bakeshop" is the earliest second unit among the Luz names.
why_wrong.o4: Files last only if the leading "The" is counted first (T). It moves to the end: Luz Garden The.

items.stem:
Using standard alphabetic filing, which name is filed FIRST?
Ana's Bakery | Ana Carinderia | Anas Printing | Anastacia Salon

reveal.terms: Punctuation is ignored. A possessive keeps its s: Ana's = Anas.
reveal.shortcut: Delete the apostrophe, keep every letter.
reveal.why_correct: Units: Ana / Carinderia; Anas / Bakery; Anas / Printing; Anastacia / Salon. "Ana" alone files first. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 3), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o1: Files first only if "'s" is dropped (Ana Bakery). The apostrophe is ignored but the s stays: Anas.
why_wrong.o2: "Anas" comes after "Ana": nothing comes before something.
why_wrong.o3: "Anastacia" is longer than "Ana" and "Anas", so it comes after them.

distractor_subreason.o1: CLR-LETTER-ORDER: drops the possessive s, breaks ARMA Rule 3

items.stem:
Using standard alphabetic filing, which name is filed LAST?
Cruz-Lim Trading | Cruz Lumber | Cruzada Store | Cruzlan Rice Mill

reveal.terms: Punctuation is ignored, and a hyphenated name is one unit: Cruz-Lim = CruzLim.
reveal.shortcut: Close up the hyphen, then compare letter by letter.
reveal.why_correct: Units in order: Cruz, Cruzada, Cruzlan, CruzLim. CruzLim is last (cruzli comes after cruzla). This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 3), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o1: "Cruz" alone files first: nothing comes before something.
why_wrong.o4: Files last only if Cruz-Lim is split into Cruz / Lim. As one unit, CruzLim comes after Cruzlan (cruzla comes before cruzli).

distractor_subreason.o4: CLR-LETTER-ORDER: splits the hyphenated name, breaks ARMA Rule 3

items.concept: personal and business name filing (ARMA rules)
items.stem:
Using standard alphabetic filing, which name is filed FIRST?
J. Ramos | Jose Ramos | Juan B. Ramos | Jo Anne Ramos

reveal.terms: An initial in a personal name is its own unit. Surname first, then given name or initial.
reveal.shortcut: A lone initial comes before every name that starts with that letter (nothing before something).
reveal.why_correct: All file under Ramos. Second units: J, Jo, Jose, Juan. The initial J is first. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 4), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o4: "Jo" comes after the initial "J": a single letter files before any name that starts with it.

items.concept: personal and business name filing (ARMA rules)
items.stem:
Using standard alphabetic filing, which name is filed FIRST?
ABC Glass | A B Cruz Store | Abaca Crafts | ABS Motors

reveal.terms: Single letters separated by spaces are separate units. An acronym written without spaces (ABC) is one unit.
reveal.shortcut: Spaces decide: "A B" is two units, "ABC" is one.
reveal.why_correct: First units: A, Abaca, ABC, ABS. The single letter A is first. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 4), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o1: Files first only if ABC is split into A / B / C. A business acronym is one unit, written as it is: ABC.

distractor_subreason.o1: CLR-LETTER-ORDER: splits the acronym, breaks ARMA Rule 4

items.stem:
Using standard alphabetic filing, which name is filed FIRST?
100 Islands Tours | 7 Seas Shipping | VII Arts Studio | Seven Hills Inn

reveal.terms: Arabic numerals first, in ascending order, then Roman numerals, then names that start with letters.
reveal.shortcut: Compare numbers by value, not by first digit.
reveal.why_correct: Order: 7, 100, VII, Seven. 7 Seas Shipping is first. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 7), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o2: Files first only if 100 is read digit by digit (1 before 7). Numbers file in ascending order: 7 before 100.
why_wrong.o3: Roman numerals file after Arabic numerals.
why_wrong.o4: A spelled-out number files with the letters, after all numerals.

distractor_subreason.o2: CLR-LETTER-ORDER: compares digits one by one, breaks ARMA Rule 7

items.stem:
Using standard alphabetic filing, which name is filed LAST?
3rd Avenue Cafe | III Kings Bakery | Three Sisters Bakery | Thomas Bakery

reveal.terms: Spelled-out numbers are filed as words. Ordinal endings (st, nd, rd, th) are ignored.
reveal.shortcut: Only digits and Roman numerals go in the number group; words go with the letters.
reveal.why_correct: Order: 3rd Avenue, III Kings, Thomas, Three. "Thr" comes after "Tho", so Three Sisters Bakery is last. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 7), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o1: Arabic numerals file first; the ordinal ending "rd" is ignored.
why_wrong.o2: Roman numerals file before any name that starts with a letter.
why_wrong.o3: Files last only if "Three" is filed as the number 3. A spelled-out number files alphabetically: Thomas before Three.

distractor_subreason.o3: CLR-LETTER-ORDER: files a spelled-out number with the numerals, breaks ARMA Rule 7

items.stem:
Using standard alphabetic filing, which name is filed LAST?
University of the East | University of Santo Tomas | University of San Carlos | Union Bank

reveal.terms: An organization is indexed as written on its letterhead, prefixes such as San and Santo join the next word (Rule 6); only a leading "The" moves to the end.
reveal.shortcut: Do not rearrange a school's name to its key word; read it as written.
reveal.why_correct: Third units (Rule 6 joins San and Santo to the next word): SanCarlos, SantoTomas, the. "the" is last, so University of the East is last. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 8), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o1: Files last only if "the" is dropped (University of East). Indexed as written, "the" is the third unit, and "the" comes after SantoTomas (Rule 6 joins Santo Tomas into one unit).
why_wrong.o2: Rule 6 joins the prefix: SanCarlos. "SanCarlos" comes before "SantoTomas" and "the" (sanc before sant).

distractor_subreason.o1: CLR-LETTER-ORDER: drops a minor word, breaks ARMA Rule 8

items.stem:
Using standard alphabetic filing, which name is filed LAST?
Ateneo de Davao University | Ateneo de Manila University | Ateneo Graduate School | Ateneo Law School

reveal.terms: An organization is indexed as written on its letterhead; a prefix such as "de" joins the word after it (Rule 6, as in gap-fill-001).
reveal.shortcut: Keep every word of the official name, in order.
reveal.why_correct: Second units (Rule 6 joins de to the next word): deDavao, deManila, Graduate, Law. "Law" is last, so Ateneo Law School is last. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 8), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o2: Rule 6 joins the prefix: deDavao. It files first (deD before deM).
why_wrong.o3: Files last only if "de" is dropped (Ateneo Manila). Rule 6 joins the prefix: deManila is the second unit, and it comes before Graduate and Law.

distractor_subreason.o3: CLR-LETTER-ORDER: drops a minor word, breaks ARMA Rule 8
